howto.name: Add the PDF
howto.text: Drop or select the PDF you want to trim, up to 500 MB.

howto.name: List the pages to remove
howto.text: Pages are written as numbers and ranges separated by commas, such as 1-3, 5, 8-end; an open range like 4- runs to the last page.

howto.name: Delete and download
howto.text: Run it and save the new PDF, which contains every page you did not list, in the original order.

faq.a: The deleted pages no longer appear in the new file, and your original PDF is untouched, so you can always start again from it. Keep the original until you have checked the result.

faq.q: How do I delete a range of pages?
faq.a: Pages are written as numbers and ranges separated by commas, such as 1-3, 5, 8-end; an open range like 4- runs to the last page.

faq.q: Is this the same as Extract Pages?
faq.a: It is the reverse. Delete Pages removes the pages you list; Extract Pages keeps only the pages you list. Both produce a new PDF and leave the original alone. Either way the pages left out are gone from the file, not hidden in it: bookmarks, links, form fields and accessibility tags that pointed to them are removed with them.

faq.q: Can I remove blank pages automatically?
faq.a: Yes — Remove Blank Pages detects empty and near-empty pages for you, which is quicker than listing them by hand after a scan.

faq.q: Will the remaining pages lose quality?
faq.a: No. The pages you keep are copied as they are, so text stays selectable and images are not recompressed.

faq.q: What happens to my PDF after I upload it?
faq.a: It is uploaded over HTTPS and processed on the PrivaTools server in isolated temporary per-request storage, using local libraries rather than a third-party service. Response cleanup removes the PDF and the result after your download is sent, and a background sweep clears anything an interrupted request leaves behind. Nothing is added to an account or file library.
